title: Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX
SINDH LAND TAX AND
AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th May, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(13)/2002, dated
11‑5‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may, be called the
Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from Rabbi 2001‑2002.

11‑5‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment in the First
Schedule to Sindh Ordinance No. XII of 2000.‑‑‑In the
Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000, in the First
Schedule, under the heading "exemption", in the Note against Serial
No.1, for the figures "4‑0", the word "twelve" and
for the figures "8‑0" the "twenty four" shall be
substituted.
